name: Lobby Tools — Missed-Call Calculator & Receptionist Quiz
author: lobbyvoices

sections.description:
Add Lobby’s no-signup business-phone tools to any post or page:

  • Missed-Call Calculator — visitors slide their call volume, missed-call rate, and job value, and see what unanswered calls cost them per year, with the recovery math shown.
  • Should I Hire a Receptionist? quiz — six questions, a straight verdict (hire, automate, or do nothing) with break-even math.

Both tools are fully interactive, auto-size to their content, work in English or Mexican Spanish, and come in dark or light themes. Great for agencies, consultants, and bloggers writing for local service businesses.

Shortcodes

  • [lobby_missed_call_calculator]
  • [lobby_receptionist_quiz]

Attributes

  • lang — en (default) or es
  • theme — dark (default) or light
  • credit — yes (default) shows a small credit link under the widget; no hides it

Example: [lobby_missed_call_calculator lang="es" theme="light"]

External services

This plugin embeds interactive tools served from lobbyvoices.com (Lobby) inside an iframe, and listens for resize messages from that iframe so the widget can match its content height.

  • What the service is: business-phone tools (calculator and quiz) hosted by Lobby.
  • What data is sent: the embedded page loads from lobbyvoices.com when a visitor views a page containing the shortcode — equivalent to visiting that site (IP address and user agent, as with any embedded content). No WordPress user data, account data, or site data is sent. The tools require no signup and set no marketing cookies in the embed.
  • When: only on pages where you place the shortcode.
  • Service provider: Lobby — terms: https://lobbyvoices.com/terms — privacy: https://lobbyvoices.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Add [lobby_missed_call_calculator] or [lobby_receptionist_quiz] to any post or page (in the block editor, use a Shortcode block).
  3. Optional: set lang="es", theme="light", or credit="no".
sections.faq:
Does it require an account?

No. The embedded tools do not require payment, signup, or an email address from the site owner or visitor.

Does it slow my site down?

No. The iframe is lazy-loaded, and the only script is a small resize listener that loads solely on pages using a shortcode.

Can I use it in Spanish?

Yes — lang="es" renders the full tool in Mexican Spanish, including results.
